info.timeAllocation: Study hour (150h) = 125h online + 9h offline + 1h TE + 2h PE + 13 h self-study
info.description: Project managers play a key role in leading, planning and implementing critical projects to help their organizations succeed. In this course, students’ll discover foundational project management terminology and gain a deeper understanding of the role and responsibilities of a project manager. They’ll gain an immersive understanding of the practices and skills needed to succeed in an entry-level project management role; learn how to create effective project documentation and artifacts throughout the various phases of a project. They will know the foundations of Agile project management, with a focus on implementing Scrum events, building Scrum artifacts, and understanding Scrum roles. Student’s also have a chance to practice strategic communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management through real-world scenarios.
info.studentTasks: Student must get the certification of Google Project Management: Professional Certificate to be accepted to the final examination
info.note:
1. Complete the online course to be allowed to take Final Exam

2. Final Exam is included of Final Theory Exam (TE) & Final Practical Exam (PE): 100%

3. Student gets 1/6 bonus points for each course completed on time. The total bonus point is not greater than 1.

4. Completion Criteria: Final TE Score >=4 & Final PE Score >=4 & FR >= 5

(FR = min(10, (Final TE Score + Final PE Score)/2 + bonus)

clos.loDetails: Describe project management skills, roles, and responsibilities across a variety of industries
Explain the project management life cycle and compare different program management methodologies
Describe the significance and key components of the different phases of the project life cycle
Evaluate various project management tools to meet project needs.
Describe how to estimate, track, and maintain a budget.
Implement the key quality management concepts of quality standards, quality planning, quality assurance, and quality control.
Explain the Agile project management approach and philosophy, including values and principles.
Demonstrate how to prioritize and analyze data and how to communicate a project’s data-informed story.
